name: HORSE
description: HORSE is a mixed poker game format that rotates through five different poker variants in a fixed sequence. The acronym stands for Hold'em, Omaha Hi/Lo, Razz, Seven Card Stud, and Eight-or-Better (Stud Hi/Lo). Popular in major tournaments like the World Series of Poker, HORSE tests a player's versatility across multiple poker disciplines. All games are played in Fixed-Limit format.

content.text: HORSE is a mixed poker game format that rotates through five different poker variants in a fixed sequence. The acronym stands for Hold'em, Omaha Hi/Lo, Razz, Seven Card Stud, and Eight-or-Better (Stud Hi/Lo). Popular in major tournaments like the World Series of Poker, HORSE tests a player's versatility across multiple poker disciplines. All games are played in Fixed-Limit format.
Developed in the United States as a way to test poker players' skills across multiple variants. Became prominent in high-stakes cash games and tournament play.
Standard deck, poker chips, dealer button.
Deal according to current game in rotation (Hold'em, Omaha, etc.).

items.text: C.H.O.R.S.E.: Adds Crazy Pineapple (C) before Hold'em; six variants in rotation. Community and stud games are evenly split.
C.H.O.R.S.E.L.: Adds Crazy Pineapple (C) and Lowball (L); seven variants. California or Ace-to-Five Lowball.
H.O.S.E.: Drops Razz; four variants: Hold'em, Omaha Hi/Lo, Seven-Card Stud, Stud Eight-or-Better. Shorter rotation.
Eight Game Mix: Eight variants: 2-7 Triple Draw, Limit Hold'em, Limit Omaha Hi-Lo, Razz, Seven-Card Stud, Stud Hi-Lo 8, No-Limit Hold'em, Pot-Limit Omaha High. Also known as T.H.O.R.S.E.H.A.
